A '''banner''' is a [[:Category:Military units|military unit]] led by a [[Banner-General]]. There are two types of banners, foot and horse.

==Foot==
A banner of foot consists of three thousand men divided into twelve [[Company|companies]] which in turn are divided into five [[squad]]s.

==Horse==
A banner of horse consists of roughly fifteen hundred [[cavalry]] divided into three [[squadron]]s which in turn are divided into ten [[troop]]s.
